$description: REFERENCE tier — what a colour IS (DECISIONS 0438; Monograph app tier 0500/0501). Named by pigment + lightness step (OKLCH L × 100). Values are the website's own Monograph palette (apps/website/DESIGN.md). Nothing outside the system tier may use these; a theme overrides them.

paper.$description: Light grounds: paper, the well (the one tinted surface), the hairline.

ink.$description: Light-mode inks: ink (headings, primary fills, strong rules), soft ink (hover on ink fills).

graphite.$description: Light-mode greys: caption grey (AA on paper and well), the placeholder grey.

night.$description: Dark grounds: paper, the well, the hairline.

bone.$description: Dark-mode inks: ink, soft ink, caption grey, the placeholder grey.

cinnabar.$description: The mark's colour. In the app it lives in the mark only (0501): never a highlight, fill or focus.

moss.$description: Live / passing — state only, a square beside words (Law 02).

ochre.$description: Waiting / changes not published — state only.

brick.$description: Errors, blocked, destructive. In the app red only means something is wrong (0501).

umber.$description: Shadow ink, for what sits above the page only (dialogs, drawers, menus).

chalk.$description: A cool white — the mark's ring on a dark ground only.
